'''Building 9819''' was a building that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], members of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] offloaded a canister of the gas [[Trinex-M]] at Building 9819. However, following an outbreak of the gas, a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] crashed into the building and destroyed it. Shortly afterwards, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] encountered the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Morth]] next to the building's remains.
